title: Nasdaq posts biggest daily drop in 19 months on AI regulation fears
en: The Nasdaq Composite fell 5.52% on Nov. 5, its biggest one-day drop in 19 months, confirming a technical correction, as chipmakers sank on fears of tougher AI regulation after Democrats won control of the US Congress. Nvidia dropped over 9%, while the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index plunged over 12%. The rout wiped out US$3 trillion in stock market value from S&P 500 companies. The S&P 500 fell 4.36% to end at 7,353.73 points, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 3.44% to 51,523.06 points. Analysts said newly elected members of Congress and governors are looking to slow the pace of AI infrastructure development, raising concerns for a growth story that has depended on rapid data-center buildout.
zh: 纳斯达克综合指数11月5日下跌5.52%，创19个月来最大单日跌幅，确认进入技术性回调，芯片股因担忧民主党赢得美国国会控制权后出台更严格的AI监管而大跌。英伟达跌超9%，费城半导体指数暴跌逾12%，标普500公司市值蒸发约3万亿美元。标普500指数下跌4.36%收于7353.73点，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌3.44%报51523.06点。分析师表示，新当选的国会议员和州长希望放缓AI基础设施的开发步伐，而AI的增长故事一直依赖数据中心的快速建设，这引发了市场担忧。

title: Bank of England raises interest rate to 4 pct amid inflation pressures
en: The Bank of England on Thursday raised its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage points to 4 percent, its first increase in more than three years, as the conflict in the Middle East drives up energy prices and fuels inflation. The Monetary Policy Committee voted 8-1 in favor of the increase, with one member calling for a larger rise to 4.25 percent. Inflation has risen to 3.5 percent and is expected to reach about 5 percent by mid-2027. "There is now enough inflationary pressure in the pipeline caused by the rise in energy prices that an increase in bank rate is warranted," Governor Andrew Bailey said, warning that unless the conflict in the Middle East is resolved, this may not be the last increase.
zh: 英国央行11月5日（周四）将基准利率上调0.25个百分点至4%，为三年多来首次加息，原因在于中东冲突推高能源价格并加剧通胀。货币政策委员会以8票对1票赞成加息，一名委员主张更大幅度加息至4.25%。英国通胀已升至3.5%，预计到2027年年中将升至约5%。行长安德鲁·贝利表示：“能源价格上涨已在传导链条中形成足够的通胀压力，上调银行利率是合理的。”他警告说，除非中东冲突得到解决，否则这可能不是最后一次加息。

title: Google to invest $17 billion in first Wyoming data center
en: Alphabet's Google said on Thursday it will invest $17 billion to build its first data center in Wyoming, pushing ahead with a major AI infrastructure investment as political resistance to data center expansion grows after the US midterm elections. The facility will be built in Laramie County in partnership with Tallgrass Energy, Black Hills Energy, American Electric Power and Related Digital. The project will be powered in part by a planned 702-megawatt fuel-cell development equipped with carbon capture and storage technology, with fuel cells supplied by Bloom Energy. Of the 41 data center-related ballot measures voted on this week, all but one went against data centers, according to Ballotpedia.
zh: Alphabet旗下谷歌11月5日（周四）表示，将投资170亿美元在怀俄明州建设其首个数据中心，在美国中期选举后数据中心扩张遭遇越来越多政治抵制之际，继续推进重大AI基础设施投资。该设施将建在拉勒米县，与Tallgrass Energy、Black Hills Energy、美国电力公司和Related Digital合作。项目将部分由一个规划中的702兆瓦燃料电池装置供电，并配备碳捕集与封存技术，燃料电池由Bloom Energy供应。据Ballotpedia统计，本周投票的41项与数据中心相关的公投议题中，除一项外全部反对数据中心。

title: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from Portugal national team after 23 years
en: Portuguese star Cristiano Ronaldo announced his retirement from international football on Thursday at the age of 41, ending a career with the national team spanning more than 23 years. "Today, my journey with the Portugal national team comes to an end. The time has come for me to return the number 7 shirt to the national team and bring an end to a career that began in August 2003 and changed my life forever," Ronaldo said. The Al-Nassr striker made 234 appearances for Portugal and scored 146 goals, both all-time records for men's international football. At the 2026 World Cup, he became the first player to score in six different editions of the tournament.
zh: 葡萄牙球星克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多11月5日（周四）宣布从国家队退役，时年41岁，结束了超过23年的国家队生涯。C罗说：“今天，我与葡萄牙国家队的旅程走到终点。是时候把7号球衣归还给国家队了，为这段始于2003年8月、彻底改变了我人生的生涯画上句号。”这位利雅得胜利前锋代表葡萄牙出场234次、打进146球，这两项均为男足国际比赛的历史纪录。在2026年世界杯上，他成为首位在六届世界杯上都有进球的球员。

title: 9th China International Import Expo opens in Shanghai
en: The ninth edition of the China International Import Expo (CIIE), the world's first national-level exhibition dedicated to imports, opened on Thursday in Shanghai. Chinese Vice Premier Ding Xuexiang delivered a keynote speech at the opening ceremony. Running from Nov. 5 to 10, this year's CIIE has attracted 4,142 overseas exhibitors, including more than 300 Fortune Global 500 companies and industry leaders. Over 480 exhibits are set to make their global, Asian or China debuts at the 2026 event, the highest number in its history, with total exhibition area exceeding 440,000 square meters. U.S. exhibitors occupy more than 50,000 square meters, leading for the eighth consecutive year.
zh: 第九届中国国际进口博览会——全球首个以进口为主题的国家级展会——11月5日（周四）在上海开幕，国务院副总理丁薛祥出席开幕式并发表主旨讲话。本届进博会于11月5日至10日举行，吸引4142家境外参展商，其中包括300余家《财富》世界500强和行业龙头企业。超480件展品将在本届展会上完成全球首发、亚洲首展或中国首秀，为历届之最；展览总面积超过44万平方米。美国参展商展览面积超过5万平方米，连续第八年位居各国首位。

title: Eiffel Tower closed amid nationwide strikes in France
en: The Eiffel Tower was closed to visitors on Thursday due to a nationwide strike in France, as demonstrations took place across the country over wages, the cost of living and public services. The Interior Ministry estimated that 600,000 people participated in the protests, while labor unions claimed a figure of 1.6 million. Nearly 10 percent of employees in the French state civil service took part in the strike over salaries and purchasing power. According to the Ministry of National Education, 15.81 percent of teachers were on strike, and nearly 33 percent of higher education institutions were disrupted. Interior Minister Laurent Nunez had announced that 70,000 police officers and security forces would be deployed across the country.
zh: 受全国性罢工影响，埃菲尔铁塔11月5日（周四）暂停对游客开放，法国各地就薪资、生活成本和公共服务问题举行示威游行。法国内政部估计约60万人参加了抗议活动，而工会方面称人数达160万。近10%的法国国家公务员因薪资和购买力问题参加罢工。教育部数据显示，15.81%的教师参与罢课，近33%的高校教学活动受到干扰。内政部长洛朗·努内兹此前宣布，将在全国部署7万名警察和安保力量。
vocab: n. 政府行政部门，公务系统
